chapters.title: Faith, and the saying of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace: “Islam is built on five”
Matters of faith
The Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe
Whose Islam is best?
Feeding people is part of Islam
Loving for one’s brother what one loves for oneself is part of faith
Love for the Messenger, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, is part of faith
The sweetness of faith
Love for the Ansar is a sign of faith
Chapter
Fleeing from trials is part of religion
The saying of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace: “I am the most knowledgeable of Allah among you”
Hating to return to disbelief as one hates to be thrown into the Fire is part of faith
The differing degrees of the people of faith in deeds
Modesty is part of faith
“If they repent, establish prayer and give zakat, then let them go on their way”
Those who say that faith is action

When Islam is not genuine, but is submission or fear of being killed, because of His saying: {The desert Arabs say, “We believe.” Say, “You have not believed, but say, ‘We have submitted.’”} When it is genuine, it is according to His saying, exalted is His mention: {Indeed, religion with Allah is Islam}
Spreading the greeting of peace is part of Islam
Chapter heading under review
Sins are among the affairs of Jahiliyyah
“If two groups of the believers fight, make peace between them”—He called them believers
Wrongdoing of differing degrees
The sign of the hypocrite
Standing in prayer on the Night of Decree is part of faith
Jihad is part of faith
Voluntary standing in prayer during Ramadan is part of faith
Fasting Ramadan seeking reward is part of faith
Religion is ease, and the saying of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace: “The religion most beloved to Allah is the upright, tolerant religion”
Prayer is part of faith
A person’s good practice of Islam
The religious practice most beloved to Allah is the most lasting
